en.name: Quick Preview
en.description: Rest the pointer on a link to another document - a Markdown link or a [[wikilink]] - to read its opening, or the section the link names, in a card beside it. Pin keeps the card open while you write.

zh.name: 快速预览
zh.description: 鼠标停在指向另一篇文档的链接（Markdown 链接或 [[双链]]）上，旁边浮出卡片显示它的开头，或链接指向的那一节；钉住后卡片一直留着，边看边写。
